server_only: ❌ This command only works inside a server.
no_permission: ❌ You need the **Manage Server** permission to change loadout images.
unknown_weapon: ❌ **{weapon}** isn't on the weapon list. Pick one of these: `{list}`
not_image: ❌ That file isn't an image. Send a PNG or JPG screenshot.
no_image_prefix: 📎 Attach the screenshot to the same message, for example `.setloadout AK117` with the image added.
no_image_slash: 📎 Add your screenshot in the **image** option, then run the command again.
saved: ✅ **{weapon}** now uses your screenshot. Members will see it next time they open the armory.
removed: 🗑️ Removed the **{weapon}** image. Members will see the setup prompt until someone adds a new one.
failed: ⚠️ I couldn't save that image. Please try again in a moment.
list_empty:
No weapon images yet. Send `.setloadout <WEAPON>` with a screenshot attached to add one.
Weapons you can set: `{list}`
